		l.OverDue10Days = true or
		l.OverDue17Days = true or
		l.OverDue31Days = true))),
		toDecrement: Set(User) = overdueUsers->select(u: User|u.SuspensionDays>0),
		alreadyZero: Set(User) = overdueUsers->select(u: User|u.SuspensionDays = 0),
		willReachZero: Set(User) = overdueUsers->select(u: User|u.SuspensionDays = 1)
	precondition:

	postcondition:

		alreadyZero->forAll(u: User|u.BorrowStatus = BorrowStatus::SUSPEND) and

}
